Your expertise in ICT product solutions will not only drive sales but also strengthen our market position through strategic development and presentation of cutting-edge ICT solutions. This position requires a blend of technical proficiency, sales acumen, and a keen ability to understand and meet customer needs. Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Solution Development and Presentation: Develop product solutions tailored to the specific needs of customers and clients. Deliver compelling presentations that highlight the value and technical superiority of our offerings. Market Intelligence and Training: Keep abreast of the latest industry trends, competitor activities, and technological advancements.
